QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_39

question.text: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations and the Code of Conduct chapter, any change in Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of an AIF shall be intimated to:

answer.text: Only to the Registrar of Companies

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (page 248), any change in the Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of an AIF shall be intimated to the investors and SEBI. The AIF must disclose its KMP and investment manager in the PPM, and KMP changes are subject to dual notification - to investors and to SEBI. The Trap: Single-recipient options miss the source-required dual-notification rule. The Registrar of Companies has its own filing regime under the Companies Act; that is separate from the AIF-specific KMP-change rule tested here. Note: Per page 366, significant changes in the key investment team are also communicated to all investors. The combination of pages 248 and 366 grounds the dual-notification answer in the source.
